```{=html}
<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 HOW THIS DOCUMENT WORKS  (architecture, part 2 of 2)

 • The tables, figures, and maps are generated by 10_results_assets.R, which writes
   them into  output_figs/_<rate_label>/ .  This document only EMBEDS them, so:
       1. tweak the model / rerun 10_results_assets.R  → assets refresh
       2. re-render this .qmd                          → document rebuilds
   Your prose below is plain text in THIS file, so it is never overwritten.

 • ALL titles + captions live in one place: the `caps` list in the setup chunk.
   Edit them there (not in the figures — the images are intentionally text-free).

 • Numbering is automatic. Anything labelled `#| label: fig-*` becomes Figure 1,2,3,4
   in order (maps included); `#| label: tbl-*` becomes Table 1,2. Reorder the blocks
   and the numbers follow. Cross-reference in prose with @fig-overtime or @tbl-gap.

 • Write your commentary in the italic *[Commentary …]* slots before/after each block
   (delete the placeholder text). Add or remove blocks by copying a block and giving
   it a new label + a new entry in `caps`.
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(readr); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
library(flextable); library(knitr)

rate_label <- params$rate_label
OUT_DIR    <- file.path("output_figs", paste0("_", rate_label))

## run metadata (written by 10_results_assets.R) --------------------------------
meta <- tryCatch(
  jsonlite::read_json(file.path(OUT_DIR, "run_metadata.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE),
  error = function(e) list(generated_date = "unknown", rate_label = rate_label, maps_drawn = NA))
gen_date  <- if (!is.null(meta$generated_date)) meta$generated_date else "unknown"
maps_ok   <- file.exists(file.path(OUT_DIR, "foresight_difference.png"))
maps_missing <- !maps_ok   # referenced by the fallback note (avoids '!expr !x' YAML clash)

## formatters (presentation lives here, not in the asset script) ----------------
fmt_pct <- function(x) vapply(x, function(v) {
  if (is.na(v)) return(NA_character_)
  if (v < 1e-4) return("<0.0001%")
  if (v < 1) { s <- formatC(v, format = "f", digits = 4)
    s <- sub("0+$", "", s); s <- sub("\\.$", "", s); return(paste0(s, "%")) }
  paste0(formatC(v, format = "f", digits = 2), "%")
}, character(1))
fmt_pct2  <- function(x) ifelse(x < 1e-4, "<0.0001%", paste0(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2), "%"))
fmt_pairs <- function(x) ifelse(abs(x) < 1, "<1", formatC(round(x), format = "d", big.mark = ","))

DELTA <- "\u0394"; DP <- paste0(DELTA, "pairs")

## palette for table text/header (moved here from the asset script) -------------
COL_MODEL     <- c(greedy = "#B0413E", myopic = "#E2A23B", rolling = "#2E7D5B")
COL_MODEL_TXT <- c(greedy = "#B0413E", myopic = "#B8801E")     # darker amber for text
GREEN_HEADER  <- "#2E7D5B"

SCEN_LAB1 <- c(rcp45_wet = "RCP 4.5 wet", rcp45_dry = "RCP 4.5 dry",
               rcp85_wet = "RCP 8.5 wet", rcp85_dry = "RCP 8.5 dry",
               stationary = "Stationary")

## grouped, model-coloured, zebra-striped table (reproduces the old flextable look,
## but rendered natively inline instead of exported to .docx) --------------------
style_grouped_table <- function(df, groups, subs, footer_text = NULL) {
  vcols  <- names(df)[-1]
  rle_g  <- rle(groups)
  top_w  <- c(1, rle_g$lengths)
  top_l  <- c("Scenario", rle_g$values)
  seps   <- c(1, head(1 + cumsum(rle_g$lengths), -1))          # right-edge group separators
  txtcol <- c(COL_MODEL_TXT, rolling = unname(COL_MODEL[["rolling"]]))
  bd     <- officer::fp_border(color = "#dddddd", width = 1)

  ft <- flextable(df)
  ft <- set_header_labels(ft, values = setNames(as.list(c("", subs)), c("Scenario", vcols)))
  ft <- add_header_row(ft, top = TRUE, values = top_l, colwidths = top_w)
  ft <- merge_at(ft, i = 1:2, j = 1, part = "header")
  ft <- bg(ft, part = "header", bg = GREEN_HEADER)
  ft <- color(ft, part = "header", color = "white")
  ft <- bold(ft, part = "header")
  ft <- align(ft, align = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- align(ft, j = 1, align = "left", part = "all")
  ft <- valign(ft, j = 1, valign = "center", part = "header")
  ft <- bold(ft, j = 1, part = "body")
  for (g in unique(groups)) {
    gcols <- vcols[groups == g]; col <- txtcol[[tolower(g)]]
    if (!is.null(col) && length(gcols)) ft <- color(ft, j = gcols, color = col, part = "body")
  }
  ft <- bg(ft, i = seq(2, nrow(df), by = 2), bg = "#f5f5f2", part = "body")
  ft <- border_remove(ft)
  ft <- hline(ft, i = 1, part = "header", border = officer::fp_border(color = "white", width = 1))
  ft <- vline(ft, j = seps, border = bd, part = "header")
  ft <- vline(ft, j = seps, border = bd, part = "body")
  ft <- padding(ft, padding.top = 4, padding.bottom = 4, part = "all")
  if (!is.null(footer_text)) {
    ft <- add_footer_lines(ft, values = footer_text)
    ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 8.5, part = "footer")
    ft <- color(ft, color = "grey40", part = "footer")
  }
  set_table_properties(autofit(ft), layout = "autofit", width = 1)
}

## build the two display tables from the raw CSVs -------------------------------
t1 <- read_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "table_over_baseline.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
tbl1 <- data.frame(
  Scenario    = unname(SCEN_LAB1[as.character(t1$scenario)]),
  greedy_pct  = fmt_pct2(t1$greedy_pct),  greedy_dp  = fmt_pairs(t1$greedy_dpairs),
  myopic_pct  = fmt_pct2(t1$myopic_pct),  myopic_dp  = fmt_pairs(t1$myopic_dpairs),
  rolling_pct = fmt_pct2(t1$rolling_pct), rolling_dp = fmt_pairs(t1$rolling_dpairs),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
groups1 <- c("Greedy", "Greedy", "Myopic", "Myopic", "Rolling", "Rolling")
subs1   <- c("% over baseline", DP, "% over baseline", DP, "% over baseline", DP)

t2 <- read_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "table_gap_vs_rolling.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
tbl2 <- data.frame(
  Scenario   = unname(SCEN_LAB1[as.character(t2$scenario)]),
  greedy_gap = fmt_pct(t2$greedy_gap_pct), greedy_dp = fmt_pairs(t2$greedy_dpairs),
  myopic_gap = fmt_pct(t2$myopic_gap_pct), myopic_dp = fmt_pairs(t2$myopic_dpairs),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
groups2 <- c("Greedy", "Greedy", "Myopic", "Myopic")
subs2   <- c("gap %", DP, "gap %", DP)

## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## CAPTIONS + TITLES — the single source of truth. Edit here.
## (Bold lead-in = the title pulled out of each figure; the rest is the caption.)
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
caps <- list(
  tbl_over_baseline =
    "**Conservation value created over the do-nothing baseline, by scenario.**",
  tbl_gap_vs_rolling =
    "**Value-added gap vs. rolling (deterministic foresight), by scenario.**",
  fig_overtime = paste(
    "**Prevented-loss shortfall vs. optimal.** Cumulative gap versus rolling",
    "(discounted duck-pairs) accumulating over the horizon, by climate scenario.",
    "Rolling is the deterministic-foresight benchmark (gap = 0)."),
  fig_decline = paste(
    "**Landscape decline under each climate future (rolling policy).** All scenarios",
    "share the 2020 anchor (5.11M pairs). Policies are near-indistinguishable at",
    "landscape scale (~0.6% of total) — the separation lives in value-added."),
  fig_foresight = paste(
    "**Rolling vs. myopic acquisition sets.** EAUs coloured by which policy buys them",
    "under each climate scenario; foresight adds the blue cells and avoids the orange.",
    "Cells are 282 km\u00b2 EAUs (ESRI:102039); grey = neither."),
  fig_prevloss = paste(
    "**Per-parcel prevented-loss difference: rolling \u2212 myopic.** Blue: rolling invests",
    "here and prevents duck-pair loss; red: myopic invests here instead; grey: no",
    "difference. Coloured cells sum to the value-added gap. Colour is capped",
    "symmetrically at the 98th percentile of |\u0394V|.")
)
```
